prompt:
Judge one fact extracted for a SysML v2 model from an engineering document. The fact names elements by their full names; the document may refer to them by aliases declared elsewhere (those declarations are included).

Fact: flow(source=Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit, payload=usable capacity constraint)

Source sentences (the last one is where the fact was extracted):
S095: The Explosives Response Team manages security holds under the applicable response procedures.
S096: A bag returns to normal handling only after its identity, examination outcome, and routing authorization agree.
S097: The East Make-Up Conveyor and West Make-Up Conveyor are selected according to the active plan and available capacity.
S098: The Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit operates within its assigned flight window and reports when its usable capacity is constrained.

"supported": every slot value is stated or directly implied by the sentences. "partially_supported": the main relation is right but a slot is wrong, over-specific or unsupported. "unsupported": the fact is not stated, contradicts the text, or assigns the wrong element. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"partially_supported","reason":"S098 says Carousel 7 Make-Up Unit reports when its usable capacity is constrained, so it is the source of a report about the constraint. But no target is named, and the payload is better described as a capacity-constraint report or status than as a 'usable capacity constraint' itself."}
